title: LiDAR Signals for Robot Locomotion: Spherical Range Images Enable Robust Sim-to-Real Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2611.27223v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing legged-locomotion systems commonly rely on depth images or online elevation maps. However, depth-based policies suffer from perceptual sim-to-real discrepancies due to imperfect depth sensor modeling, while map-based approaches are vulnerable to drift and misalignment. LiDAR offers direct measurements of the surrounding geometry, but raw LiDAR scans lack a compact, structured representation for high-frequency control. We propose a LiDAR perception pipeline that maintains perceptual consistency across simulation and reality through sensing- and representation-level alignment. At the sensor level, we recover frame-wise angular sampling patterns from the physical LiDAR and replay them in simulation with GPU ray casting. At the representation level, simulated and real returns undergo the same spherical range image encoding, yielding a fixed-size policy observation for end-to-end training and direct deployment without teacher--studen

translated_title: 用于机器人运动的激光雷达信号：球面距离图像实现鲁棒的仿真到现实迁移
translated_abstract: 现有的腿式运动系统通常依赖深度图像或在线高程图。然而，基于深度的策略由于深度传感器建模不完善而存在感知层面的仿真到现实差异，而基于地图的方法则容易受到漂移和错位的影响。激光雷达能够直接测量周围环境的几何结构，但原始激光雷达扫描缺乏适用于高频控制的紧凑、结构化表示。我们提出了一种激光雷达感知管线，通过传感器级和表示级的对齐来保持仿真与现实之间的感知一致性。在传感器层面，我们从物理激光雷达中恢复逐帧的角采样模式，并使用GPU光线投射在仿真中进行重放。在表示层面，仿真和真实点云回波经过相同的球面距离图像编码，产生固定大小的策略观测，用于端到端训练和直接部署，无需教师-学生蒸馏。
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于球面距离图像编码的激光雷达感知管线，通过传感器级和表示级的双重对齐实现仿真与现实间的感知一致性，使腿式机器人无需教师-学生蒸馏即可实现鲁棒的仿真到现实迁移部署。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a LiDAR perception pipeline with spherical range image encoding that achieves simulation-to-reality perceptual consistency through sensor- and representation-level alignment, enabling robust sim-to-real transfer for legged robot locomotion without teacher-student distillation.
